trail: The inspected CBS interview transcript attributes the exact six-word sentence to Freeman.
Wikiquote independently records the same wording and cites contemporary Associated Press coverage dated 15 December 2005.

context.heading: Why it mattered
lead: Freeman’s comment concerns the relationship between Black history and the national story. In the surrounding exchange, he objects to confining that history to one month. Removing that setting can make the sentence sound like an isolated slogan rather than part of his argument.
